name: Lighthouse rock
hints: The rowboat at the end of the jetty goes back to Brindlebrook.
Tap the ground to walk. The keeper's house is up the steps. The rowboat at the jetty goes back.

then: Mind the steps on your way down. They are slick after dark.
else: A visitor! The boat hardly ever brings anyone out here.
If you are going under the bluff, take these. My sister brews them, and the dark down there is hard on people.

tower: The tower door is locked. High above, the lamp turns.
boat: The rowboat knocks gently against the jetty. You row back to the shore road.
